name: SteamTinkerLaunch
description: Default-on Steam Deck self-updater does unsigned git pull; downloaded tools (GE-Proton, Winetricks, ReShade, SpecialK) only WARN on checksum mismatch and still extract (content-as-code).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: SteamTinkerLaunch has separate tool-maintenance paths, including a checksum comparison for custom Proton content. The original assertion covering all named tools is not established by this subset.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release; the named GE-Proton/Winetricks/ReShade/SpecialK paths were not all connected to this checksum branch, and no execution/build testing was performed.

original_evidence.text: | SteamTinkerLaunch | github.com/sonic2kk/steamtinkerlaunch | 8550ab26 / 2025-07-14 | Y (Steam Deck only) | **Y, default-on** (`STEAMDECK_AUTOUP="1"`, line 3249) | Y (self via `git pull`, plus dozens of tool downloads: GE-Proton, Winetricks, ReShade, SpecialK, Conty, Vortex, Arch-package deps) | HTTPS (git/wget/curl to github.com/reshade.me/archive.archlinux.org/nightly.link); no `-k`/`--insecure`/`--no-check-certificate` found anywhere in the ~27k-line script | N/A | **None** for self-update (plain `git pull`/`git clone`, no commit/tag signature check, `lib` `gitUpdate()` line 6947-6963); for GE-Proton/Conty/Vortex/FWS: sha512/sha256/md5 checksum fetched from the *same* GitHub host, and on mismatch `dlCheck`/`chkFile` only logs a WARN and **still extracts the archive** (`chkFile` line 842-864, `dlCustomProton` line 4409-4469) | none (no GPG anywhere in the codebase; `grep -n "gpg\|signature\|pubkey"` returns no genuine hits) | `steamtinkerlaunch:26560-26584` (`installFilesSteamDeck`); `:6947-6963` (`gitUpdate`); `:4409-4469` (`dlCustomProton`); `:842-864` (`chkFile`, non-blocking checksum) |

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: Y (self via `git pull`, plus dozens of tool downloads: GE-Proton, Winetricks, ReShade, SpecialK, Conty, Vortex, Arch-package deps)

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS (git/wget/curl to github.com/reshade.me/archive.archlinux.org/nightly.link); no `-k`/`--insecure`/`--no-check-certificate` found anywhere in the ~27k-line script

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: **None** for self-update (plain `git pull`/`git clone`, no commit/tag signature check, `lib` `gitUpdate()` line 6947-6963); for GE-Proton/Conty/Vortex/FWS: sha512/sha256/md5 checksum fetched from the *same* GitHub host, and on mismatch `dlCheck`/`chkFile` only logs a WARN and **still extracts the archive** (`chkFile` line 842-864, `dlCustomProton` line 4409-4469)

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: none (no GPG anywhere in the codebase; `grep -n "gpg\|signature\|pubkey"` returns no genuine hits)
